name: prismamd
description: Open-source, mobile-first 3D MMD animation app for Android & iOS.

scripts.android: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
